title: Add trusted self-hosted recovery validation path
rawUserRequest: GitHub Actions is unavailable, so development progress must not be blocked. Add the recommended maintainer-dispatched, self-hosted recovery validation path without weakening hosted merge or release gates.

declaredIntent.summary: Provide bounded diagnostic feedback during a GitHub-hosted Actions outage while retaining the full hosted compatibility matrix as the only merge and release evidence.

outOfScope: GitHub required-check configuration, branch protection, runner registration, deletion, and service lifecycle; only adding ai-cockpit-recovery to repository runner 21 is in scope
Executing code from pull_request events on a self-hosted runner
Any claim that recovery workflow results are merge or release evidence

sources.reason: Defines the hosted compatibility matrix that remains the required merge and release evidence.
Documents the distinction between local/diagnostic checks and governed quality or release gates.
Existing workflow topology tests establish the repository regression-test convention.
Records the existing independent CI evidence capability whose workflow topology test is extended by this Work Item.
Official incident evidence: GitHub Actions was in major_outage when the user authorized the recovery path.
Repository-owned runner 21 is online with only default self-hosted, macOS, and X64 labels; the user authorized adding the isolated recovery label.

riskAssessment.reason: A personal macOS runner must never become an untrusted pull-request execution surface or be mistaken for the hosted cross-platform matrix.

reasons: CI trust-boundary and evidence-classification changes require standard governance.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly accepted a diagnostic self-hosted path that does not relax hosted verification.

preReviewWarnings: Review dispatch-only trigger semantics, exact runner-label isolation, fixed SHA checkout, and explicit non-release evidence wording.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Untrusted pull-request code cannot trigger or execute on the personal runner.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The recovery workflow declares workflow_dispatch only and has no pull_request or push trigger.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A maintainer dispatch runs only on the dedicated macOS recovery runner.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow requires self-hosted, macOS, X64, and ai-cockpit-recovery labels.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add exact-label workflow assertions and document runner provisioning.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A successful recovery run is not mistaken for compatibility, merge, or release evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Workflow and documentation label every result diagnostic/non-release and preserve the hosted matrix unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Assert wording and forbidden workflow changes; review docs against quality-gate policy.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A new recovery workflow is runnable only by workflow_dispatch and has no push or pull_request trigger.
The recovery workflow requires the exact labels self-hosted, macOS, X64, and ai-cockpit-recovery, and checks out a maintainer-provided immutable source commit.
The workflow runs a bounded diagnostic quality command that is supported on macOS and publishes an explicit non-release result summary.
tests/test_workflows.py prevents trigger, label, source-identity, and non-release-boundary regressions.
Operational documentation defines runner provisioning, dispatch procedure, security limits, evidence classification, and the required return to hosted verification after recovery.
guidelines: Do not execute untrusted fork or pull-request code on a personal self-hosted runner.
Recovery evidence is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy compatibility, merge, or release gates.
Document operational commands and security boundaries with the workflow change.

intent.problem: A GitHub Actions outage prevents timely feedback from hosted runners, but changing the required hosted matrix or running untrusted public pull-request code on a personal machine would weaken both evidence and security.
constraints: Dispatch-only; no push or pull_request trigger.
Use an isolated custom recovery label in addition to macOS/X64 self-hosted labels.
Require an immutable source commit input and verify it after checkout.
Do not alter compatibility.yml, smoke.yml, release.yml, branch protection, or required checks.
Results must remain non-release, non-merge diagnostic evidence.
intent.rationale: A deliberately narrow maintenance-only route restores feedback during external outages while preserving the hosted matrix as the sole authoritative cross-platform gate.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized automatic execution and explicitly accepted a dedicated maintainer-dispatched self-hosted recovery path; approval is limited to adding ai-cockpit-recovery to repository runner 21.
